name: AI Deep Dive — CRM — 2026-05-02
rationale: Salesforce (CRM) dominates enterprise software with its core CRM and growing Agentforce AI suite. The company has heavily focused on operational efficiency, pushing net margins to nearly 18% and generating massive free cash flow ($14.4B). The market is overly pessimistic about top-line deceleration (pricing the stock at $183 with a forward P/E of 12.3x), ignoring the massive cash generation and share buyback potential. My weighted fair value of $281 indicates a deep 53% upside, making CRM a strong value-oriented BUY.
